instructions: This is a separate, unpublished Go module (its own go.mod) that runs explain/ against live Postgres, MySQL, and MariaDB behind the `integration` build tag — it deliberately pulls in real DB drivers the core modules must not, and is not on the per-query hot path. Tests skip when their DSN env var is unset; each statement should get its own deadline (a standalone context, not the shared test context, so it stays safe inside t.Cleanup). Don't suggest replacing the pinned, version-dependent tabular EXPLAIN assertions with fixtures or mocks — the version drift across MySQL/MariaDB/Postgres is exactly what these tests exist to catch.
